title: Low-Interaction-Rank Learning: Unifying Multiplicative Dual-Encoder Heads
abstract: arXiv:2608.11661v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A multiplicative dual-encoder network computes a real-valued output for a pair of inputs as the inner product of their separate encodings. This architecture has been developed independently in operator learning, bipartite matching, contrastive vision-language models, retrieval, and other areas, yet no unified theory guides the basic design decisions: how many interaction modes to represent, how to normalize the encoders, and when the architecture should be avoided. We provide such a foundation by introducing the class of functions of low interaction rank, a class whose intrinsic complexity is measured by its interaction spectrum. translated_title: 低交互秩学习：统一乘法双编码器头
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11661v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：乘法双编码器网络通过将一对输入的各自编码进行内积计算，输出一个实数值。这一架构在算子学习、二分匹配、对比视觉-语言模型、检索等领域被独立发展，但尚无统一理论指导基本设计决策：应表示多少交互模式、如何归一化编码器，以及何时应避免使用该架构。我们通过引入低交互秩函数类来提供这一基础，该类别的内在复杂度由其交互谱衡量。在此框架内，近似误差分解为谱截断项和编码器实现项；样本复杂度由两个编码器复杂度之和而非乘积决定；基于谱衰减的可用性标准确定了该架构何时能够成功。
tldr: 本文提出低交互秩函数类，为乘法双编码器架构提供统一理论基础，将近似误差分解为谱截断和编码器实现，并指出样本复杂度由编码器复杂度之和决定，从而指导设计决策。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the class of low interaction rank functions, providing a unified theoretical foundation for multiplicative dual-encoder architectures, decomposing approximation error into spectral truncation and encoder realization, and showing sample complexity governed by the sum of encoder complexities.
